notes.content:
Minor bug fix.

If you are having issues launching the app on the Steam Deck, go to Settings for the game -> Compatibility -> Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool -> Select Proton 8.0-4.

Notes from the previous release:

- Refinement of the UI.
- Ability to control volume through settings.
- Minor pacing/balancing updates.
- Less obtrusive notification of developer commentary.

Hope you enjoy :-)
